title: Worst-case cost growth bound
statement: For every $d\in\mathbb{N}$, the worst-case expected query cost of the level-$d$ randomized tree is at most $\frac{2}{\rho}\rho^d$, where $\rho=(1+\sqrt{33})/4$.
